comparison.objective: Transfer and quarter-turn-lock an air-line gladhand to the correct trailer connector, versus set and jam-lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1960 requires hose handling, face alignment, seal compression, and bayonet rotation; the candidate requires two-tool screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1960 requires the correct connector, small plate gap, lock-stop angle, pull retention, and release; the candidate requires angular-setting accuracy and cycle repeatability.
comparison.reason: Connector mating and bayonet locking are different from preserving an adjustable stop while tightening a jam nut.
